info.title: Innovationsbox API
info.description: REST API for the Innovationsbox platform — project ideas, moderation, project spaces, notifications.

get.description: Returns all moderation categories. Requires authentication.

post.description: Creates a new moderation category. Requires moderation.review permission.

put.description: Updates an existing moderation category. Requires moderation.review permission.

delete.description: Deletes a moderation category. Fails with 409 if the category is still assigned to ideas. Requires moderation.review permission.

get.description: Returns all reviews with status Pending. Requires moderation.review permission (roles: moderator, administrator).
Returns the full review with embedded idea data. Auto-locks the idea to UnderReview status if it was Submitted. Requires moderation.review permission.

post.description: Approves the moderation review, triggering idea approval and project space creation. Requires moderation.review permission.
Rejects the moderation review with a reason. Requires moderation.review permission.
Sets the review to feedback_requested status and notifies the submitter. Notes are required. Optional deadline. Requires moderation.review permission.

get.summary: List all users with expert status
get.description: Returns all active users including their expert flag. Requires moderation.review permission.

put.summary: Toggle expert flag for a user
put.description: Adds or removes the user from the Experte group, dispatching the appropriate event. Requires moderation.review permission.

expert.description: Set to true to grant expert status, false to revoke

get.description: Returns notifications for the current user. Currently returns an empty array (not yet implemented).

post.description: Marks a single notification as read. Currently a stub (not yet implemented).

get.description: Returns a list of all project ideas with their ID, title, and current status.

post.description: Creates a new project idea. Requires the idea.submit permission (roles: initiator, administrator).

get.description: Returns the full details of a single project idea.

delete.description: Deletes a project idea. Only the submitter or an admin can delete.

get.description: Returns all project ideas submitted by the currently authenticated user, in all statuses.
Returns a list of all categories. No authentication required.
Returns a paginated list of public project spaces with card data. No authentication required.

Returns details of a single project space. Response shape depends on the caller's role: public visitors get basic info; members also get collaboard links, status updates, and member list; initiators and admins additionally see pending membership requests.

post.description: Adds a Collaboard collaboration link to the project space.

delete.description: Removes a Collaboard collaboration link from the project space.

post.description: Adds a status update to the project space.

put.description: Edits an existing status update. Only the space initiator or admin can edit.

delete.description: Deletes a status update. Only the space initiator or admin can delete.

post.summary: Request to join a project space
post.description: Submits a membership request for the current user.

put.summary: Accept or reject a join request
put.description: Allows the space initiator or an admin to accept or reject a pending membership request.
Transitions a project space to a new status. Valid transitions: draft → active → completed → archived.

post.summary: Invite a user to a project space
post.description: Directly invites a user to become a member of the project space.

get.description: Returns experts from the Experte group who are not already members or have pending requests.

post.description: Sends an expert request to join the project space.

put.summary: Accept or decline an expert request
put.description: Allows the expert to accept or decline the request.

post.description: Current user leaves the project space.

delete.summary: Remove a member from a project space
delete.description: Removes a member. Only the space initiator or admin can remove members.

post.summary: Upload a header image for a project space
post.description: Uploads and sets the header image on a project space. Only the initiator, moderator, or admin may call this.

delete.summary: Delete the header image of a project space
delete.description: Removes the header image from a project space. Only the initiator, moderator, or admin may call this.

get.description: Returns expert requests for the current user (pending or decided within last 90 days).
Returns the health status of all system services (database, CMS). Disabled in production via monitoring.health_enabled config.
